answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A marble of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quartz of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the sonnet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
